text: Platoon 5! Where are my people?! We need one person for the dance competition!
Corper! Instant passport, 500 naira. Stand here, look here. Don't smile.
This one is serious.
Abeg show me the official post!
I know somebody
Uncle corper, what is the answer?
Iron? Kettle? Ah, you want to cook inside hostel? I will pretend I did not see. Enter. Run to registration!
Medium don finish since morning. Na only large and extra large remain. Which one you want?
You don collect alert?
Your khaki is too big. 1,000 naira and it will fit like Agbada.
Have you checked the group? Something about clearance.
One snap for your Instagram, 500 naira.
PLATOON 5… ATTENTION!
Corper, compile JSS2 scores. Ah, and a parent called. Her son scored 38. She said you should make it 50 and she will 'appreciate you'.
Make some noise for Platoon 5!
ABOUT… TURN!
Small don finish since morning. Na only large and extra large remain. Which one you want?
Next! Corper, what is your size?
Welcome! Today is sanitation in the compound before the sensitisation talk. Pick up every sachet and bottle, then sign the register.
Right thumb here. Again. Left thumb. Again. Okay. This is your state code. You are in Platoon 5. Next!
Double bunks, 60 to a room. Somebody is already charging a phone from a socket that looks unsafe.
Statement of result? Medical fitness certificate?
Rice and beans with fried plantain, 1,200 naira. Hot!
Na rumour! LGI never talk am!
RIGHT… TURN!
Four passport photographs, white background.
Danfo dey stop for Corper Close B/Stop, 300 naira. Or trek — e no far, like 120 metres.
No CDS today o. Hall is busy. Check your group.
My corper! Bucket, torchlight, mosquito net. Everything you need for camp.
Corper! Corper!
LEFT… TURN!
Corper, are you sleeping?!
DJ, play Afrobeats!
Corper, it is past 10. Register is closed. Your name will go to the LGI as late.
Danfo dey stop for Corper Close bus stop, 300 naira. Or trek — e no far, like 120 metres.
Corper, thank you for today. Take this small transport money. See you on Monday, not Wednesday.
Enter with your change o!
Light just went. Your phone is at 31%. Tomorrow is Thursday.
Who no get change make e come down!
From the LGI: You were absent from CDS on Thursday without permission. Explain in writing within 48 hours why disciplinary action should not be taken.
Good morning. Call-up letter and green card.
No money, no movement.
Go to the clinic tent, they will sign it. Come back to me, don't join the queue again.
Where is my JSS2 teacher?
Secretariat! Secretariat!
Next! Next!
Corper! How far?
Large khaki, white shorts, white T-shirts, crested vest, jungle boots, canvas. Sign here. Next!
Corper, the children are talking about your class! Take this small transport money. See you on Monday, not Wednesday.
Corper, clearance is inside, Hall B. Join the queue, no dulling.
Who get the energy?!
One chance remain!
Malaria? Headache? Homesick? We have paracetamol for all three.
Who said no clearance without CDS card?!
Aunty corper, what is the answer?
Corper! Where is your call-up letter?
STAND… AT EASE!
Platoon 5, fall in!
Model School? Enter. Hold your bag well.
Hmm. Ikeja… Lagos. Okay. Open that bag. Let me see what you carry.
Shift! Shift! Four four for back!
Your posting is out. Ikeja L G A, Lagos. Your place of primary assignment is Corper Close Model School. Clearance is every month at the L G A Secretariat.
Are you trying to bribe me?! Frog jump to registration! Go!
Then go and bring it! You think this is a party?
Corper, punctuality is the soul of business!
Secretariat! Make we see your leg!
You are a corper, not a contractor. Classroom, now.
Extra large khaki, white shorts, white T-shirts, crested vest, jungle boots, canvas. Sign here. Next!
Welcome, corper. We have no Maths teacher for JSS2 since January. You will take them. The class is waiting.
Phone charging 100 naira per hour. No stealing, we have CCTV. (There is no CCTV.)
You are number 23. Don't go far o.
Ojota, Ikeja, Secretariat!
